# Zluri

> > Zluri is a next-gen identity governance and administration (IGA) platform that automates access management, SaaS visibility, and compliance across organizations.

Zluri provides comprehensive identity lifecycle management, shadow IT discovery, and access governance solutions designed to reduce security risks and optimize SaaS spend. The platform integrates with major identity providers like Okta and Google Workspace, supporting compliance standards including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI DSS.

## Key Topics

- Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)
- SaaS Management
- Access Management
- Access Reviews
- Shadow IT Discovery
- Identity Lifecycle Management
- User Provisioning
- Deprovisioning
- AI App Governance
- Compliance Automation
- SSO Integration
- SCIM Protocol
- SOC 2 Compliance
- ISO 27001
- HIPAA

## Core Platform

- [Zluri | Next-Gen Identity Governance and Administration](https://www.zluri.com): Zluri's next-gen IGA platform for identity governance, access management, and compliance automation.
- [User Access Management | Zluri](https://www.zluri.com/access-management): User access management with provisioning, deprovisioning, and least-privilege access automation.
- [User Access Reviews | Zluri](https://www.zluri.com/access-reviews): Automated user access reviews for audit compliance, risk detection, and remediation.
- [Identity Lifecycle Management | Zluri](https://www.zluri.com/solutions/identity-lifecycle-management): Identity lifecycle automation for joiner-mover-leaver provisioning and deprovisioning.

## SaaS & Shadow IT Governance

- [SaaS Management | Zluri](https://www.zluri.com/saas-management): SaaS management solution for shadow IT detection, cost optimization, and vendor governance.
- [Monitor Shadow IT | Zluri](https://www.zluri.com/solutions/monitor-shadow-it): Shadow IT discovery and monitoring with app visibility and compliance risk reduction.
- [Monitor AI Apps | Zluri](https://www.zluri.com/solutions/monitor-ai-apps): AI application discovery and governance for security, compliance, and risk management.

## Integrations & Alternatives

- [Zluri + Google Workspace](https://www.zluri.com/okta-alternative/zluri-google-workspace): Zluri integration with Google Workspace as Okta alternative for identity management.
